_comment: Deploy-time settings read by patch-forms.py and verify.sh. formEndpoint: the /exec URL of the Google Apps Script web app (source: forms-apps-script.gs) bound to the book site's Google Sheet; it appends each of the three forms (Free chapter, Reserve, Press invite) to its own tab. Never reuse another site's endpoint. legal: values for the {{HEBERGEUR}} and {{EMAIL_PRESSE}} tokens Design leaves in the legal text; fill-placeholders.py writes them into both pages, and EMAIL_PRESSE also becomes the press mailto address.
